incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: SEV2 - `RateLimiter unexpected-throttle` on prod (/v1/generate). 429 spike observed across multiple tenants. Pager: pagerduty

pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-307654 - acknowledged by charlie

charlie: acked. I'm oncall. assigning to ben for ops escalation. tagging maria for quota-mapper context.

ben: seeing 429s starting ~10:42 UTC. graphs show token rate steady but throttle count jumps. looks like quota-mapper returning a fallback "deny" tag for some tenants.

maria: we rolled quota-mapper v2.4 to prod ~10:30 UTC (small priority-tie change). might be related. investigating config precedence.

alice: quick customer impact check: samples show clients get `quota_exceeded` for otherwise healthy requests. partial 429s, not full outage. estimated affected p50->p90 requests up by ~3% global.

charlie: good. prioritized mitigation: (1) put limiter in soft-mode for affected tag-range, (2) roll back quota-mapper to v2.3 if config change is the cause.

ben: preparing soft-mode command now. executing admin override to stop hard 429s while we assess.

ben: run: 
```
curl -X POST 'https://admin.internal/api/ratecap/override' \
  -d 'selector=tenant:.*-prod&mode=soft&reason=incident-307654'
```

ben: override applied. limiter responses should start returning 200s with a warning header. monitor for backpressure.

maria: pulling mapper logs. pattern shows tag precedence flipped when tenant tag `region` was null -> matched default rule that sets `limit:0`. that explains misapplied quota.

alice: sample 429 payload:
```
{"error":"quota_exceeded","tag":"tenant:acme-prod","limit":100,"usage":101}
```

charlie: thanks. ben, start rollback of quota-mapper to v2.3. deploy-bot, can you initiate a rollback canary?

deploy-bot: rollback pipeline started for quota-mapper -> target v2.3. canary on 10% of hosts. logs: `deploy-rollback-307654`

ben: canary healthy so far (10 minutes). throttle counts dropping on canary hosts.

maria: confirming: v2.3 mapping yields correct precedence; v2.4 had an inadvertent default-rule that set `limit=0` when region is missing. creating hotfix to make rule explicit + unit test.

charlie: good. keep override in place until full rollout of rollback. notify support to pause churny customer emails.

alice: support: @support-team - hold on escalation emails for affected tenants; we're mitigating.

ben: increasing sampling to capture tenant list affected for postmortem. dumping distinct tenant IDs with 429 in last 15m: `acme-prod, globex-eu, tiny-startup` (list incomplete, collecting).

maria: patch ready for code review to add explicit matcher. will cut v2.4.1 after rollback completes.

deploy-bot: rollback to v2.3 fully rolled out at 10:58 UTC. all hosts on v2.3.

charlie: confirm rate metrics: 429 count trending back to baseline. latency stable. good.

ben: removing soft-mode override in 5m after monitoring window. schedule: remove at 11:10 UTC if signals stable.

alice: customer impact note for incident timeline draft: 10:30 UTC deploy v2.4 -> 10:42 UTC spike in 429s -> 10:46 UTC PD page -> 10:50 UTC soft-mode override -> 10:58 UTC rollback complete -> 11:10 UTC soft-mode removed -> post-rollout monitoring.

charlie: filing interim incident report and paging oncall-docs. cc @maria for root cause writeup.

maria: root cause summary: config precedence change in quota-mapper v2.4 led to default rule matching tenants with missing region tag, applying `limit=0`. regression slipped past unit tests because no synthetic with missing region existed. fix: add explicit defaults + add synthetic test coverage.

ben: mitigation + long-term actions: (1) improved pre-deploy synthetic tests, (2) feature-flag mapper precedence changes behind kill-switch, (3) add alert for sudden spike in `limit=0` tag assignments.

charlie: final ops note: postmortem owner assigned: maria. draft due EOD tomorrow. close this thread after confirmation from support that no further alerts.

alice: support confirms customer-impact emails paused; will prepare outbound communication if required. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-307654 - resolved by charlie (ack->resolved).

charlie: closing incident. final check: no regressions in the last 30m. thanks everyone. :tada:
